create_mistral_config: create a MistralConfig instance to initialize a Mistral 7B style model configuration
initialize_mistral_model: initialize a MistralModel from a MistralConfig configuration object
access_model_config: access the configuration from a trained MistralModel instance via model.config
configure_kv_heads: configure MistralConfig with custom num_key_value_heads for grouped query attention
set_rope_parameters: set rope_parameters on MistralConfig for rotary embedding configuration
